english.note: Use this for a small amount, including abstract amounts such as “not an ounce of regret.”

exampleSentences.english: I don't have an ounce of regret about this.

english.note: For the small-amount sense, this is the all-purpose everyday choice.

exampleSentences.english: I don't have a particle of patience left; I don't want to wait any longer.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我一啲耐性都冇，唔想再等喇。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 di1 noi6 sing3 dou1 mou5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 dang2 laa3

english.note: Use 一啲 as the all-purpose noun phrase for a very small amount of something, including the non-liquid extension of this sense.

exampleSentences.english: I only want a drop of water.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zing6 hai6 soeng2 jiu3 jat1 di1 seoi2
